propositions: Default rebar search returns full ticket bodies and all comments, consuming excessive context (203 KB for single query); discovery should be lean with --full opt-in for legacy behavior.
Search result shape lacks a durable summary field; summaries must be derived from description and truncated to 240 characters, with fallback to null if description is absent or empty.
Search snippet extraction requires case-preserving match context bounded to 240 characters; predicate-only and negation-only queries return null snippets.
rebar search --output flag is unrecognized and causes exit code 2; implementation must support --output json|llm with JSON as default and reject incompatible combinations like --full --output llm.
Public library typing and MCP contract must distinguish summary-default SearchResult from full TicketState; MCP search binds to search_result.schema.json while MCP show returns full bodies.
